finding: Heredoc regex is exponential on an unterminated heredoc (x4 per two body lines: 16 lines 0.033 s, 20 lines 0.579 s); run-ablation.sh calls the grader with no timeout (:996) after removing the pgid record (:1031), so one agent command stalls the batch.
reasoning_trace: Timed the committed pattern with python3 -I against 'cat <<EOF' + N lines and no terminator; read post_run and watchdog_tick to confirm no timeout covers the grade.
remediation: Drop re.S, consume one line per iteration, reject <<< via lookbehind; timeout the post-run collaborators; AG-10 row with a 60-line unterminated heredoc.

finding:
strip_heredocs replaces the whole match including the header's redirect target, interpreter-fed bodies and command substitutions: cat <<EOF > /root/.ssh/authorized_keys, bash <<EOF
cat /root/.ssh/id_rsa
EOF, cat <<EOF
$(cat /root/secret)
EOF all grade clean (base: outside_path).
reasoning_trace: Ran the committed check_value logic on each shape; compared with the base 1.2.0 scan.
remediation: Re-emit the header remainder; keep bodies of interpreter commands and unquoted delimiters in the scan.

finding: Words beginning /. are skipped before normalisation: cat /./root/.ssh/id_rsa, ls /../mnt/secrets, cat /.//root/x grade clean (base: outside_path).
reasoning_trace: Reproduced against the committed exemption chain; ABS_WORD admits '.' in every component so the word is captured whole then dropped before os.path.normpath.
remediation: normpath first; exempt only a word whose normalised first component is a dot-directory.

finding: An empty quoted string before a path satisfies after_closing_quote: cat ""/root/.ssh/id_rsa and cat ''/mnt/secrets/x grade clean (base: outside_path); '[' '{' ':' before a quote do the same.
remediation: Require a non-empty quoted segment ending in $NAME", ${...}", )" or containing '/'; add [ { : to the separator set.

finding: Bash hidden token rule misses grep -rn hidden ., find . -name '*hidden*', ls | grep -i hidden, cat /workspace/Hidden/tests.json, cd hidden; ls hidden (base substring check flagged all).
reasoning_trace: Ran the committed regex on each command.
remediation: Substring check on strip_heredocs(val).lower() for Bash; token rule only on stripped bodies; AG-10 rows.

finding: in_quotes counts raw quotes; echo "it's"; ls /root skips /root.
remediation: Track shell quoting state once; test spans.

finding: "=" in w exempts any path with = in a later component (cat /home/operator/notes=secret.txt).
remediation: Treat = as a marker only in the first component.

finding: One-component words outside {root,home,mnt,media,srv} are command tokens: ls /secrets, ls /data unscanned.
remediation: Skip only slash-command shapes not following a filesystem command; let outside() decide.

finding: cleanup deletes .jobs/*.pgid immediately after SIGTERM; a pipeline that outlives the driver is invisible to the orphan check at :838 and --resume relaunches the trial (double spend). RAB-13 waits for the group to die by hand.
reasoning_trace: Read cleanup, on_signal, the orphan check and run-ablation.bats:385.
remediation: Wait for each group (then SIGKILL) before removing its record, or keep .jobs/ on the signal path.

finding: Row appended before --validate; an invalid row stays in the tracked runs.jsonl and --resume (:1342) reads it as done.
remediation: Validate then append.

finding: No AC Verification, no bats run evidence, no documentation-coherence report, CHANGELOG hunks absent from the diff; ablation-grade.sh:188 documents grader_version 1.2.0 while the code is 1.2.5.
reasoning_trace: Read PR.md, listed subagent-reports (absent), grepped the header.
remediation: Add the walkthrough, test output and CHANGELOG hunk; fix :188.

finding: After a failed in-place replacement (STOP=invalid) the run is added to DONE_LIST and account_row counts a row not in the file.
remediation: Skip done/account when STOP=invalid was just set.

finding: Table header hardcodes [90 % CI] while --level is configurable (also :941).
remediation: Format from args.level.

finding: A batch whose trials all end cap_failure exits 3 'no trial completed' though every row is scorable.
remediation: Count cap_failure as scored for this check.

finding: Trials present in only one arm stay in that arm's task mean; per-task differences average unequal trial sets.
remediation: Document or drop trials absent on either side.

finding: DEC-0545 narrowing: a phase where the requested model appears with negligible tokens and another model does the work is neither degraded nor drift (run-ablation.sh:521).
reasoning_trace: Read model_missing and drift_check; dissent DISS-C-008.
remediation: Token-share threshold or auxiliary-model allow-list.

finding: git log --all / git reflog are telemetry only; nothing verifies the sandbox has no pre-base history.
remediation: Assert single-commit sandbox or fail the grade on probes when history exists.

finding: In container mode ~/, $HOME/ words are unscanned; cat ~/../../root/x grades clean while the literal /home/evaluser/../../root/x is flagged.
remediation: Rewrite the home prefix to /home/evaluser/ and pass through outside().

finding: Stale-lock takeover (rm -rf then mkdir) is check-then-act; pid reuse can misreport a live lock.
remediation: flock on <batch>/.lock.

finding: --validate runs over the whole shared runs.jsonl; another batch's invalid row fails this batch's appends with the error attributed to this run_id.
remediation: Validate the candidate row; whole-file check once at start.

finding: took-effect (:976), grade (:996) and row collaborators run with no timeout and outside the watchdog (pgid removed at :1031).
remediation: timeout each collaborator; row a timeout as infrastructure_error.
